principle: GrossCoordinationValue = VerifiedValue + CoordinationGain + FutureComputeSaved - RuntimeCost - RecoveryDebt - HumanMicromanagementCost.

missions.name: Docker Desktop recovery from I/O failure
missions.direct_value: Docker engine operational and build/execution verified
missions.coordination_gain: No factory reset; all project data, images, volumes preserved
missions.dependency_unlock: BuildKit, container runtime, future AI/connector workloads
missions.memory_gain: Failure fossil retained; recovery policy now Canon
missions.recovery_value: Reduced failure recurrence cost through evidence-based policy
missions.failure_debt_reduction: 24G safe margin policy, workload admission policy

missions.name: Local model serving via FinalAI/Ollama
missions.direct_value: OpenAI-compatible local inference for multiple surfaces
missions.coordination_gain: Single model store (Ollama) services multiple consumers
missions.future_compute_saved: Avoids re-downloading qwen3/llama3.1 for each surface
missions.duplicate_work: LM Studio 26G and Pieces 14G hold overlapping model/index capability
missions.failure_debt: If Ollama dies, LM Studio may act as fallback

missions.name: OpenAPI Home capability primitives
missions.direct_value: 18 discrete tools available (time, weather, filesystem, git, sql, rag, slack, pse, etc.)
missions.dependency_unlock: Extends Devin beyond filesystem to network, search, chat, memory
missions.coordination_friction: Medium (port sprawl exists but APO Gateway already holds unified registry and proxies; health/lease per tool not verified)
missions.duplicate_work: time and time-ui overlap; auth has 3 token variants; summarizer has 2 dirs
missions.failure_debt: If a server port changes, consumers via APO Gateway are shielded; central registry exists. No health/lease enforcement per tool; no auto-restart verified.
missions.human_micromanagement_cost: Medium (currently launched by shell scripts; no auto-restart verified)

missions.name: Multi-IDE surface redundancy
missions.coordination_friction: High (each IDE has separate extensions, caches, settings, language servers)
missions.duplicate_work: Language server / extension / code cache duplication
missions.failure_debt: Dormant 17G+ of VS Code family data; if needed, extensions reinstall

missions.name: Multi-model store redundancy
missions.direct_value: Multiple local inference options (GGUF, MLX, ONNX)
missions.future_compute_saved: Possible if models shared across runtimes
missions.coordination_friction: Medium (duplicate nomic-embed in LM Studio; AITK variants; Ollama cloud refs)
missions.failure_debt: Incomplete 14B AITK download; old llmster bundles; staged Bionic update

missions.name: HyperAI governance and recovery
missions.direct_value: Canon, memory, recovery artifacts, health bridge
missions.coordination_gain: Shared memory reduces drift across sessions

gross_summary.key_leverage_action: Resolve OpenAPI registry sprawl and model store duplication. These two changes unlock the highest gross value by reducing friction and debt without touching active user data.

verdict_reasoning: System produces more value together than isolated actors: Docker recovery and HyperAI Canon are strongly positive. Model and OpenAPI fabrics are valuable but carry high coordination friction and storage debt. ECONOMICS axis is understaffed, preventing centralized admission.
